name: Common Paper
description:
Common Paper is a contract platform for revenue and legal teams. Create templates, customize contracts, negotiate terms with counterparties, collect signatures, and kick off billing - all from one workflow.

This connector brings your agreement data into Claude. Ask what's waiting for signature, look up a counterparty's terms, compare payment schedules across active contracts, or draft and send a new NDA from your standard template without leaving the conversation.

Supports any kind of agreement including NDAs, Cloud Service Agreements, DPAs, BAAs, Professional Services Agreements, Letters of Intent, Pilot Agreements, Software Licenses, and Design Partner Agreements. Read tools run without interrupting you; anything that creates, sends, or voids an agreement always asks first.

Requires a Common Paper account. Authentication is handled through OAuth - no API key needed.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Common Paper to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Common Paper to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.commonpaper.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Common Paper MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common Paper lists 28 MCP tools, including archive-attachment, archive-template, create-agreement, create-invitation, download-agreement-pdf, generate-shareable-link, get-agreement, get-agreement-history, get-invitation, get-me, get-organization, and get-template.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Common Paper?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Common Paper in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Common Paper MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common Paper requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Common Paper is developed by Common Paper. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
